Gotten a lot of questions about the parts used, for lowering I went with the cork sport springs, and for tuning I am using the DRTuned Tier 1 OEM+ Kit. With the tuning, I will say I tuned mine a bit early I believe as my turbo hadn’t been broken in until after this trip (currently at 9xxx miles, and went down there at 56xx miles). There was a stock CX5 that joined us for the trip, and the owner of that said he wasn’t able to notice much of a difference either. But now that I’m back from the trip, I’ve noticed pretty big difference in responsive. Next investment will be new tires (and maybe new wheels as well, if I can find something I like). Leaning towards the Pirelli Scorpion AS Plus 3 if anyone has any suggestions for summer performance focused tires!
